files.summary: retire historical save-file and cross-agent restrictions without closing unfinished offer storage
edits: original estimate was 750–950 logic lines, excluding documentation, for saved world state and a consent rule crossing the domain, server, protocol, client and character-decision layers. Seven other agents were working in parallel at that time; the allocation below is historical coordination, not a standing lock on those files

till sit in the world-settings save record rather than a catalogued table. The original implementation was forbidden to edit save code, which explains the deviation from the “growing collections are catalogued” rule; that local task restriction is not a continuing ban. [BW20](../maintainers/base-world.md#bw20--consent-aware-handover) retains the current correction through the existing record/save owners, with coordinated current-format capture/restore/validation and no legacy reader. The [save contract](../save-and-load.md#current-subsystem-integration) remains authoritative
